tasks.title: Project Setup and Architecture Configuration
tasks.description: Initialize the Next.js 15.4 project with TypeScript, TailwindCSS, and Shadcn UI components. Set up the monorepo structure with shared types.
tasks.details:
1. Create a new Next.js 15.4 project with App Router:
```bash
npx create-next-app@latest property-website --typescript --tailwind --app
```
2. Set up monorepo structure with shared types:
```bash
mkdir -p packages/shared/types
```
3. Configure TailwindCSS:
```bash
npm install -D tailwindcss postcss autoprefixer
npx tailwindcss init -p
```
4. Install and configure Shadcn UI:
```bash
npm install @shadcn/ui
npx shadcn-ui init
```
5. Set up project structure:
```
/app
  /[locale]
    /page.tsx
/components
  /ui
  /layout
  /features
/lib
  /utils
/public
  /locales
/packages
  /shared
    /types
```
6. Configure TypeScript paths in tsconfig.json for monorepo imports
7. Set up ESLint and Prettier for code quality
8. Create initial environment variables (.env.local) for API endpoints and third-party services
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Verify project structure is correctly set up
2. Run linting checks to ensure code quality standards
3. Test TypeScript configuration with sample imports
4. Verify build process completes without errors
5. Check that environment variables are properly loaded

tasks.title: Internationalization Implementation
tasks.description: Implement Next.js i18n with URL-based routing to support Bulgarian, English, and Russian languages with proper localization structure.
tasks.details:
1. Configure Next.js internationalization in next.config.js:
```javascript
module.exports = {
  i18n: {
    locales: ['bg', 'en', 'ru'],
    defaultLocale: 'bg',
    localeDetection: true,
  }
}
```
2. Create locale directories in app/[locale]
3. Set up translation files in JSON format:
```
/public
  /locales
    /bg
      /common.json
      /home.json
      /property.json
    /en
      /common.json
      /home.json
      /property.json
    /ru
      /common.json
      /home.json
      /property.json
```
4. Create a translation utility function:
```typescript
// lib/i18n.ts
export async function getTranslations(locale: string, namespace: string) {
  return import(`../../public/locales/${locale}/${namespace}.json`).then(
    (module) => module.default
  );
}
```
5. Implement language switcher component
6. Set up middleware.ts for language detection and redirection
7. Create layout files for each locale to handle language-specific metadata
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Test URL-based routing for each language (/bg/, /en/, /ru/)
2. Verify browser language detection works correctly
3. Test language switcher functionality
4. Verify translations load correctly in different components
5. Test fallback behavior when translations are missing

tasks.description: Create the database schema with Prisma for all core entities including Listings, Agents, Users, Bookings, Alerts, Categories, and Locations with multilingual support.
tasks.details:
1. Define Prisma schema for core entities with proper relationships:
```prisma
model Listing {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt
  title       Json     // {"en": "...", "bg": "...", "ru": "..."}
  description Json     // Multilingual content
  price       Float
  size        Float
  bedrooms    Int
  bathrooms   Int
  type        String
  status      String   @default("active") // active, pending, sold
  features    Json     // Array of features
  images      String[] // Cloudinary URLs
  slug        String   @unique
  viewCount   Int      @default(0)
  
  // Relations
  agentId     String
  agent       Agent    @relation(fields: [agentId], references: [id])
  categoryId  String
  category    Category @relation(fields: [categoryId], references: [id])
  locationId  String
  location    Location @relation(fields: [locationId], references: [id])
  bookings    Booking[]
  favorites   Favorite[]
  
  @@index([agentId])
  @@index([categoryId])
  @@index([locationId])
  @@index([type, price])
  @@index([createdAt])
}

model Agent {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt
  name        String
  email       String   @unique
  phone       String
  photo       String?  // Cloudinary URL
  bio         Json     // Multilingual content
  listings    Listing[]
  bookings    Booking[]
}

// Add remaining models: User, Booking, Alert, Category, Location, Favorite
```
